svg.title: Eight decoding setups: where the low-concurrency advantage ends
svg.desc: 33 text cells: 1–4 agents, 10 turns per agent, ~126k growth cap. TP=2, context 131070, 4 slots, BF16 KV, 10 GiB ARC. Eight image-input cells are separate.
svg.text: Eight decoding setups: where the low-concurrency advantage ends
33 text cells: 1–4 agents, 10 turns per agent, ~126k growth cap. TP=2, context 131070, 4 slots, BF16 KV, 10 GiB ARC. Eight image-input cells are separate.
Total wall time (s; lower is better)
Total wall time (s; lower is better)
Total wall time (s; lower is better)
Swift non-spec has two n=4 sweep observations; both points are shown. Lines connect the first observation at each agent count.
Repeat-spread floor ≈15%; smaller gaps are unresolved. Pool varies by boot (2.61–4.30×); it is not a controlled speculation-only A/B.
Effective ingest includes cache reuse and queueing; it is not kernel prefill speed. Tooltips retain cell IDs and exact values.
